text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To witness Eishin Flash's run firsthand, 
you watch the Japanese Derby together with 
Curren Chan.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The race concluded with an upset victory 
by the underdog Eishin Flash. The entire 
venue erupted in a whirlwind of 
excitement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Merely focusing on strengthening social 
media promotions won't be enough to fire 
people up like today's race...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Realizing this, Curren Chan resolved to 
discover the kind of cuteness that would 
make people love her even more.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To build up the strength needed for that, 
she decided to enter the Hakodate Sprint 
Stakes as part of her training.
